test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Sanyukta has to bake fifty-one cakes for the anniversary party.

options.text: Fifty-one cakes will be baked by Sanyukta for the anniversary party.
Fifty-one cakes had to be baken by Sanyukta for the anniversary party.
Fifty-one cakes have to be baked by Sanyukta for the anniversary party.
Fifty-one cakes has to be baked by Sanyukta for the anniversary party.

solution:
The correct answer is **"****Fifty-one cakes have to be baked by Sanyukta for the anniversary party."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the active voice sentence, the subject is** "Sanyukta," **the verb is** "has to bake,"** and the object is **"fifty-one cakes for the anniversary party**."
 
• We must move the object to the beginning of the sentence and make it the new subject.
 
• We must add the original subject **("Sanyukta")** at the end with the preposition **"by"** to indicate the doer of the action in the passive voice.
 
• Structure__:
 __
 
• Subject + has/have + to + V1 + Object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + has/have + to + be + V3 + by + Subject __(Passive Voice)__
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Disha has to arrange things. *(Active Voice)
 
• *Things have to be arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• We must use the past participle of the main verb ("bake") and add it to the new subject.
 
 
• Past participle of **"bake": baked**
 
• Passive verb phrase: **have to be baked**
 
 
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

Correct sentence: *Fifty-one cakes have to be baked by Sanyukta for the anniversary party.*
